independent_model.description: own RK4 (0.05/0.1 s), own WGS-84 inverse geodesy, point-mass + J2 written from constants, US76 layers + isothermal stratopause continuation, Mach-interpolated Cd, ambient-corrected thrust with linear-Isp model -- coefficients from the vehicle YAML (design input); guidance callback shared with the main model by design (the authored script is the controller, declared zero on the budget)

landing_phase.note: the E8-05 corridor-origin landing re-flight stays a design_input check: this probe is the first landing-phase attempt from the handoff state the mission actually reaches

reflight.bb_cutoff.time.basis: event bisection (main) vs 0.05-0.1 s step boundary (twin); measured 0.25 s

reflight.bb_cutoff.position.basis: cutoff sampling boundary + burn-integration difference; measured 194 m

reflight.bb_cutoff.speed.basis: burn termination boundary sampling; measured 3.5 m/s

reflight.entry_peak_q.basis: density-profile form line measures 5.1% of the 4.8% delta (the whole discrepancy is the two density profiles, residual 0)

reflight.entry_peak_g.basis: follows the q line; measured 0.28 g

reflight.impact_time.basis: gravity-line dominated (J2 difference alone 0.31 s); measured 0.76 s

reflight.impact_position.basis: numerical 116 m + gravity 111 m lines dominate; measured 544 m

reflight.impact_speed.basis: terminal descent speed is density-profile sensitive: the atmosphere form line measures 8.7% (the whole delta, residual 0); same relative band as the E8-05 ascent debris-impact speed check

comparison.budget_note: frame line: both models integrate in ECEF at the same epoch with the same Earth-rotation rate -- declared zero; controller line: both fly the identical authored _Mission script -- declared zero; atmosphere line re-runs the twin on the main model's density profile (orbitopt.entry, labelled perturbation experiment); numerical line halves the twin step; gravity line drops J2 from the twin

analytical.label: Analytic solution
analytical.proves: the numerics reproduce the closed-form solution of the model they integrate (the equations and the integrator, not their agreement with reality).
analytical.cannot_prove: that the model represents reality -- the closed-form reference shares the model's own assumptions (point mass, impulsive burns, idealised field).

independent_model.label: Independent model
independent_model.proves: two independently formulated models agree, so neither is trivially mis-implemented.
independent_model.cannot_prove: that either model is right in the real world -- an assumption shared by both stays invisible; the phase and force inventory of the comparison bound its reach.

historical_telemetry.label: Historical telemetry
historical_telemetry.proves: the model reproduces a published, observed (flown) value it was not tuned to.
historical_telemetry.cannot_prove: any other vehicle, phase or operating point -- one published event validates that event, not the model as a whole, and the reference's own provenance is only as good as its source.

design_input.label: Matches design input
design_input.proves: the solver reached the aim point, or the plan respects the site/vehicle/corridor envelope it was designed against -- internal consistency only.
design_input.cannot_prove: anything about fidelity to reality: the reference IS the design input, so this is NOT independent validation and must never be read as historical proof.

numerical_consistency.label: Numerical consistency
numerical_consistency.proves: integration error is under tolerance and the model's own invariants / self-consistency hold (step convergence, exact integrals, a same-model re-fly).
numerical_consistency.cannot_prove: agreement with any other model or with reality -- it bounds numerical error only.

findings: re-flight started from the actual DC8 hot-staging separation handoff (OT run ot-ec11389b-da42dd33, separation t=125.0 s, handoff digest 60b3130118befaba86d8806d8f539adb6de4e1099ef129104934d52f768ab99c); no declared-corridor state was used

two-burn unpowered entry remains NOT CLOSED at the real DC8 separation (main-model verdict ['CORRIDOR_MISSED', 'ENTRY_Q_LIMIT_EXCEEDED']) -- consistent with the E10-01 VEHICLE_CAPABILITY finding; the independent twin agrees on the trajectory, not on closure

landing burn unplannable from the real crossed handoff (['LANDING_INFEASIBLE']) -- the terminal comparison is ballistic impact, and the E8-05 corridor-start landing check is hereby recorded as design_input, not full-chain independent verification
